MANOSABA_LIN_EVENT_GUARD_ONE_EVENT.pages:
[jitter][b]The flames twisted in front of my eyes, and the air was filled with the smell of rust and ink. [/b][/jitter]
The fire was no longer a fire—it had a crack. There is something[jitter][b][/b][/jitter] looking at you over there.
A [jitter][color=#cccccc] [voice] [/color][/jitter] came from the depths, as if reading a verdict:
[jitter][color=#cccccc] "You are here. Then, the witch trial begins" [/color][/jitter]

You take a step forward. That [jitter][color=#cccccc] [Voice] [/color][/jitter] laughed. You feel some kind of power pouring into your body, but you know - the enemy ahead is no longer who you thought it was
Obtain 13 HP points and upgrade a card, but the boss will be replaced.

You backed away. A sound of [jitter][color=#cccccc] [sigh] [/color][/jitter] came from the crack. The pain of the wound has lessened, but that [jitter][color=#cccccc] [voice] [/color][/jitter] lingers in your mind.
Recover 13 HP and upgrade a card

The rift closes behind you. Your body feels lighter, but your heart feels heavier. At the top of the tower ahead, what awaits you is no longer an ordinary monster. That [jitter][color=#cccccc] [voice] [/color][/jitter] whispers in your ear:
ZXQ 4Q

The wound heals miraculously, but your fingers are shaking. You looked down at your hand and found that you were holding a [b][color=#CC6666] pen [/color][/b]. Who gave that to you? you do not know. The fire was restored to its original state. But you know, this is by no means the last time you see that [b] illusion[/b]
